funnel._calendlyUrl: The event of /g/uk-ai-visibility (2b6f4168-ecb4-45a4-b565-aadb51fe96ce, owned by Sondre), shared on purpose: the same host, the same meeting. An own event could not be made under Sondre's user through the API on 28 Nov 2026. Zap 2 therefore reads a booking from this page as campaign uk-ai-visibility; the task is still found by its lead_id, in the same list, and keeps the tag geo-alone that Zap 1 gave it.
